about.title: About
paragraph:
I’m from Madagascar, where I earned a degree in Chemical Engineering. I took a job in the field of EHS (Environment, Health and Safety) where I quickly grew frustrated from repetitive tasks and manual processes.

I wanted to **automate, optimize, and build tools that can make work easier.** That curiosity led me to coding which I learned step by step on my own.
Then a life-changing opportunity appeared : **School 42** opened in my country. I made the decision to fully commit in learning programming.

Alongside IT, I’ve always loved art : drawing, painting, sculpting, and later UI/UX design.

**Frontend development felt natural**, it’s like drawing with code. Since functionality is just as important as aesthetics, I am also actively **improving my backend development skills.**
Today, I’m a **Fullstack Junior Developer** who enjoys creating efficient solutions for people who are also tired of repetitive work and want tools that genuinely improve their daily lives.

42.title: Likeo
42.description: Likeo is a social media app that allows users to share their thoughts, photos with friends or within their group. It features a user-friendly interface, real-time chat, group management.
42.contribution: I was part of the frontend team, implementing the user interface and ensuring a seamless user experience. I collaborated closely with the backend team to integrate APIs and optimize performance on the features : real-time chat, group management, search.

42.title: Webserv
42.description: Webserv is an HTTP/1.1 web server, built from scratch. It supports GET - POST - DELETE methods, file uploads, PHP CGI, and a file-based configuration system (routing and server settings).
42.contribution: I developed some core functionalities such as request parsing, response generation, the CGI (Common Gateway Interface) for dynamic content.

42.title: Inception
42.description: Inception involves dockerizing a Wordpress application. It includes setting up a Docker environment, creating Dockerfiles, and configuring the necessary services (Nginx, MariaDb, Wordpress) to run the Wordpress application smoothly.

42.title: Cub3D
42.description: Cub3D is a real-time raycasting rendering project that creates a 3D environment using a 2D map. It uses raycasting techniques to render the scene
42.contribution: I worked on the 2D map parsing, and was in charge of the 3D rendering from the calculation made by my partner : sprite rendering, texture mapping, and interactions within the 3D environment.

42.title: Minishell
42.description: Minishell is a shell implementation that provides basic functionalities such as command execution, input/output redirection, and piping. It is designed to mimic the behavior of a typical Unix shell while being lightweight and efficient.
42.contribution: I worked on the input parsing, error handling, signal management and the implementation of built-in cd command.

personal.title: Periodic Table
personal.shortDescription: Fun and interactive way to learn chemistry
personal.description: The Periodic Table project is an interactive web application designed to help users learn about the chemical elements in a fun and engaging way. It features a visually appealing interface that allows users to explore the properties, atomic structure, and other relevant information about each element.

personal.title: Vote API
personal.description: The Vote API is a backend application that provides endpoints for creating and managing polls, allowing users to vote on various topics. It includes features such as user authentication, poll creation, voting functionality, and result tracking.
